text:
alex_springboard: Hi Redwood team — SpringboardRx here. We're looking to onboard a custom model we call 'Domainizer' to classify and tag incoming medical billing notes (mostly US-based claims). A few hard constraints: must not leak PHI, must run in a VPC/private deployment with KMS/HSM for keys, and we need an eval plan for entity-level F1. Can you confirm what info you need and rough timeline/cost?

jessica_cs: Thanks Alex — welcome! Quick q's to start: is Domainizer a fine-tuned open model or a proprietary model binary? Do you have a scrubbed eval set we can use? Also any preferred uptime/latency SLAs?

alex_springboard: It's a fine-tuned 13B (we used Llama2 family as base). We can provide a PII-redacted eval set (50k tokens, 2k examples). Target perf: entity F1 >= 0.92 for NER-ish tags, and p50 latency ~120ms allowed at peak qps ~30 req/s. We'll need HSM for key wrapping and audit logs.

omar_success_mgr: Ok noted. Proposed onboarding flow: 1) intake call + security questionnaire, 2) security review (SOC2/KMS/HSM checks), 3) perf/eval run on dedicated pool, 4) canary rollout + enablement. Estimated calendar: 2 weeks for security review if docs complete, 1 week for perf runs. Budget/commit options we can discuss after perf.

tian_eng: Technical notes from eng: we support int8 quantized artifacts and private deployments. For your target p50 we recommend dedicated pool (4xA10G or similar) with continuous batching disabled for lowest tail latency. Fallback plan: keep a 7B distilled variant for cost fallback.

tian_eng: Example staging config we can spin up quickly:
```
deployment: private
capacity: dedicated-4xa10g
model: domainizer-13b-int8
quantization: int8
batching: auto
security: vpc, kms=true, hsm=true
rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%
```

jessica_cs: Alex, can you upload the redacted eval set to the secure intake link? Also we need your SOC2 / privacy policy PDF. I'll schedule a 45m intake call — pls add @tian_eng and @omar_success_mgr.

qa-bot: New ticket created: CS-2026-789 — "SpringboardRx: Domainizer private onboarding". Intake form linked: https://redwood-internal.example/intake/CS-2026-789

deploy-bot: Checklist updated on project board: Onboarding -> Security review, Perf eval, Canary rollout, Enablement session.

alex_springboard: Uploaded the eval set (redacted) and SOC2 link. FYI model was quantized with ONNX int8, we can share artifact S3 link for transfer once NDA and transfer method confirmed. Budget constraints: prefer 3-month reserved option if perf looks good.

omar_success_mgr: 3-month minimum reserved capacity is doable; we can propose a discounted commit if you convert after POC. We'll also document renewal risk triggers (e.g., < 60% of expected qps for 30 days).

tian_eng: For the eval run, please include: 1) canonical prompts + few-shot examples, 2) expected labels for strict matching, 3) tolerance for entity spans. We'll run both accuracy and cost-per-token profiling. Suggest we run a 24-hour soak test to observe cache warmup behavior.

jessica_cs: Next steps for Redwood: I'll set up the intake call for Friday 10am PT, create a one-pager for enablement, and kick off the security reviewer. @alex_springboard please confirm attendees and any blackout windows.

alex_springboard: Friday 10am PT works. Attendees: me (Alex), our ML lead Priya, and infra lead Marco. Thanks — looking forward. One more ask: can Redwood provide an optional fallback policy to route to a cheaper model during off-peak to save cost?

tian_eng: Yes — we can configure traffic-splitting and automatic fallback to domainizer-7b. We'll include that in the rollout plan and can tune thresholds (latency >250ms or queue >40) to trigger fallback.

omar_success_mgr: I'll include renewal/commit options in the pricing memo after perf run. For now, we'll treat this as a POC with clear evaluation gates.

jessica_cs: Great — I'll confirm calendar invite and link the intake assets in the ticket. Closing loop here for now. :thumbsup:

alex_springboard: Awesome, thanks everyone. We'll be on the Friday call.
